plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch covariate
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a 12000 x 12 raw integer gene-level count matrix from salmon (counts.csv, gene symbols in the first column) plus a 12 x 3 sample table (metadata.csv) carrying condition (treated, control; 6 each) and a two-level processing batch that is balanced across conditions. The research question is which genes differ between treated and control, with the batch acknowledged.

Because each batch holds both conditions, the batch is estimable alongside the condition and belongs in the design as a fixed effect (~ batch + condition) rather than being removed from the counts before testing — pre-adjusting counts and then testing them inflates confidence. T1S1 first establishes whether the batch or the condition dominates the sample structure (blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes), so the model choice is checked against the data rather than assumed. T1S2 then runs the pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), the DESeq2 Wald test on ~ batch + condition with control as the explicit reference level and the contrast condition_treated_vs_control, apeglm shrinkage for the reported effect sizes, and BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering on. T1S3 runs the same counts and the same design through edgeR quasi-likelihood as an independent method; with 6 per group the two tools agree on most genes but not all, and the intersection is the defensible high-confidence set. T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes — ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic, the stated choice among the disputed ranking metrics because it scales the effect by its uncertainty — into fgsea against the human MSigDB Hallmark collection and then Reactome, both of which are present in the reference store as human symbol GMTs matching the gene-symbol identifier space of the count matrix. T1S4 consolidates diagnostics, tables, and the reproducibility record.

Scale caveat stated up front: 12 samples and 12000 genes is a small, ordinary two-group experiment. It supports a gene list with FDR control and a pathway-level reading; it does not support claims about subgroups, interactions, or mechanism.

fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic, Hallmark then Reactome
Consolidated report with MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram, DESeq2/edgeR overlap, leading edge genes, session info

Results table per collection with pathway, NES, pval, padj, size, and leading-edge genes
Redundant significant sets collapsed by leading-edge overlap with one representative reported per group and the full table kept
The number of genes at padj < 0.05 from T1S2 is stated, and no over-representation test is run on a list shorter than ~50 genes
constraints: Never threshold the ranked list before fgsea — the full tested list goes in
Rank by the DESeq2 Wald statistic; do not rank by the unshrunken log2 fold change alone or by a signed p-value
Use human gene sets only; a mouse or rat collection against these HGNC symbols fails silently as an empty result
Universe for any list-based test is the tested genes, never the whole genome
Set and record the random seed before the permutation test
caveats: Enrichment results depend strongly on the method and collection; present each set as a hypothesis, not a demonstrated mechanism
Gene length and expression level bias set-level tests; the ranked test on the tested-gene list mitigates but does not remove this
If the human Reactome sets cannot be resolved at run time, report the Hallmark result alone and record the missing second collection — the analysis is not blocked by its absence

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested list is the default enrichment (R-0107); human order is Hallmark then Reactome (R-0048, R-0098). Disputed ranking metric R-0108: the Wald statistic side is chosen, per R-0099, because it scales the effect by its uncertainty.

steps.name: Consolidated DE and enrichment report
steps.question: What is the reproducible, fully-specified answer to which genes and processes differ between treated and control kidney samples?
steps.description: Assemble one report from T1S1-T1S3 and T2S1. State up front: the method (DESeq2 Wald with apeglm shrinkage, cross-checked with edgeR QL), the design ~ batch + condition with control as reference, the contrast condition treated vs control and its sign convention, the thresholds (padj < 0.05, BH, independent filtering on), the number of genes tested after filtering out of 12000, and the number of DE genes per direction. Include the two fit diagnostics before any gene table: the MA plot with significant genes marked, and the dispersion plot showing per-gene estimates, the fitted trend, and the shrunken values. Include the p-value histogram from T1S2. The gene table carries, per gene, the unshrunken log2FoldChange, the apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, and the lfcSE, and ranks genes by the shrunken value — never by the unshrunken estimate alone. Add a volcano plot and a heatmap of the top genes on the blind-VST values annotated by condition and batch. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap from T1S3 with the intersection labelled the high-confidence set. For the enrichment, state the collection and its version, the ranking metric (Wald statistic), the universe (tested genes), the size window, the tool version, and the multiple-testing method; list the leading-edge genes per significant set and mark leading-edge overlap between reported sets; state explicitly that enrichment results are method-dependent and are hypotheses for follow-up. Close with a reproducibility record: sessionInfo, every package version, the random seed used in the permutation test, and the gene set collection versions. State plainly the limits of a 12-sample two-group design — no subgroup, interaction, or mechanistic claims are supported.
steps.context: Everything a reader needs to reproduce and judge the result must be in this one artifact, including what the design cannot answer.
acceptance_criteria: Method, package versions, design formula, contrast with sign convention, thresholds, n genes tested, and n DE genes per direction all stated before the gene tables
MA plot and dispersion plot both present, before the gene tables, each with a one-line statement of what it shows
p-value histogram included
Gene table carries unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, and lfcSE, and is ranked by the shrunken value
Volcano plot and top-gene heatmap on blind-VST values annotated by condition and batch
DESeq2 vs edgeR counts and intersection size reported, with the intersection named the high-confidence set
Enrichment section states collection, version, ranking metric, universe, size window, tool version, multiple-testing method, and lists leading-edge genes per significant set with overlap marked
Explicit statement that enrichment results are method-dependent and are hypotheses
Reproducibility record with sessionInfo, package versions, random seed, and collection versions stored with the results
A limitations paragraph states the n=6 per group scale and what it does not support
constraints: Rank and plot genes by the shrunken log2 fold change; keep the unshrunken estimate and its standard error in the table
Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Do not state a pathway hit as an established mechanism
If the significant gene list is short or empty, report that plainly rather than relaxing the threshold to produce a longer list
caveats: A batch effect that dominates PC1 in T1S1 should be reported alongside the DE result, since it explains why the unadjusted comparison would differ
Genes with NA padj come from two distinct causes (Cook's outlier flagging and independent filtering) and must not be merged into one count

grounding.reason: Report contents follow the returned report-step rules: required fields (R-0041), shrunken and unshrunken effects (R-0085), MA and dispersion diagnostics (R-0087), two-method overlap (R-0042), enrichment provenance and method-dependence (R-0051, R-0055), leading edge (R-0105), reproducibility record (R-0086).
